title: TrashCans issue #38: [Crash] Failing to find corelib dependency
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (none) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by jackhexed]
Minecraft 1.18.2
Trashcans 1.0.18-forge-mc1.18
Corelib 1.1.15-forge-mc1.18

**Steps to Reproduce**
Install the trashcans mod (through curseforge client, which automatically installs dependencies) and launch the game.

**Crash report (~/logs/latest.log)**
[latest.log](https://github.com/SuperMartijn642/TrashCans/files/13370809/latest.log)

[comment by SuperMartijn642 (owner)]
The CurseForge launcher sometimes doesn't download dependency files correctly. Please delete the core lib file from your mods folder and download it manually from the website

[comment by jackhexed (none)]
This worked, thank you <3
